basis: Western election astrology: the supplied timing marker is a Mercury retrograde period beginning on election day, 6 November 2012. Mercury retrograde at a vote is classically read as repetition/return — the electorate revisits and re-confirms the existing state of affairs rather than installing a new ruler — which favours the incumbent. The contest is incumbent Obama versus challenger Romney in a competitive race; no candidate charts were supplied, so the panel-style judgement rests on the election-day signature (retrograde onset = return of the incumbent) over raw polling closeness.
prediction_text: Winner: Barack Obama — re-elected. The Mercury retrograde beginning on election day (6 November 2012) is read as a return/repeat signature: the incumbent is returned to office and Mitt Romney's challenge fails, despite the race polling competitively. Direction: Obama wins a second term, decided on the 6 November 2012 vote.
